args.content:
## Hawaii Packing List

### Essentials
- Passport and ID
- Travel documents (flight itinerary, hotel reservation, etc.)
- Travel adapter for Hawaii (Type A and B)
- Wallet and credit cards
- Hawaii state ID (if applicable)

### Clothing
- 3-4 swimsuits
- 2-3 pairs of shorts/beach pants
- 4-5 tops/t-shirts
- 1-2 light jackets for cooler evenings
- 1-2 pairs of comfortable walking shoes
- Sandals/flip-flops
- Dressy outfit for dinner at Luau

### Snorkeling Gear
- Mask
- Snorkel
- Fins
- Wetsuit (recommended for colder waters)
- Waterproof phone case

### Beach Essentials
- Beach towel
- Sunscreen
- Sunglasses
- After-sun lotion
- Insect repellent
- Beach bag

### Personal Care
- Toiletries (toothbrush, toothpaste, etc.)
- Shampoo/conditioner
- Body wash
- Razor and shaving cream
- Makeup and makeup remover
- Hairbrush/comb

### Electronics
- Phone and charger
- Laptop and charger (if necessary)
- Camera and charger
- Portable charger
- Universal power adapter

### Miscellaneous
- Reusable water bottle
- Snacks (granola bars, etc.)
- Reading material
- Beach reading material
- Travel-size games
- Collapsible cooler bag

### Hawaii-Specific
- Hawaii state ID (if applicable)
- Proof of car insurance
- Car rental agreement
- Rental car information

### Activities
- Molokini Crater snorkeling trip (June 13)
- Luau dinner reservation
- Road to Hana drive
- Waterfall hike
- Whale watching tour (optional)

### Notes
- Check the weather forecast before departure
- Pack light layers for cooler mornings and evenings
- Bring a small daypack for daily excursions
- Don't forget sunscreen with high SPF
- Consider packing a small first-aid kit
- Bring a portable charger for your phone
- Hawaii has strict recycling policies, consider packing reusable bags and containers
- Bring a small umbrella for unexpected rain showers
